title: Essay: Who Should Reduce Food Waste?
prompt:
In your English class you have been discussing food waste and sustainability. Your teacher has asked you to write an essay for homework, giving your opinion on the following statement, using the notes below to help you.

'Reducing food waste is mainly the responsibility of individual households, not supermarkets or governments.'

Notes
- household habits and planning
- supermarket policies (packaging, sell-by dates, discounting)
- government regulation

Write an essay discussing TWO of the points in the notes. You should explain which point you think is more important in relation to the statement, giving reasons to support your opinion. You may, if you wish, make use of the notes provided, but you should use your own ideas as far as possible.
notes: Look for: a clear introduction that frames the issue without simply copying the prompt; two body paragraphs each developing one chosen point with specific, plausible reasoning rather than vague assertion; an explicit comparison of which point matters more (not two parallel, disconnected lists); a conclusion that reaches a reasoned opinion rather than simply restating both sides; a good range of linking devices and vocabulary around sustainability/consumer behaviour rather than repeating simple words like 'waste'/'bad'.
